_comment: Dev environment. Switch with: flutter run --flavor dev --dart-define-from-file=config/dev.json
_relay: RELAY_BASE_URL must be a bare https origin — no path, no query. lib/core/config/flavor.dart falls back to its own compiled-in default if this is missing or malformed, and dio_client.dart pins HostAllowlistInterceptor to whichever host wins, so the app still dials exactly one host (FR-004).
_placeholder: Set RELAY_BASE_URL to your own dev worker origin.
